squire.name: Squire
squire.desc: Spend: +2 to the selected card, free.

herbalist.name: Herbalist
herbalist.desc: Spend: your next trail space ignores the rising rule.

acolyte.name: Acolyte
acolyte.desc: Spend: your next altar offering ignores odd/even.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.desc: Combined ≥ 12: obliterate the current dungeon room and gain its rewards.

spells.name: Divination
spells.desc: Sweep the Omen Row and reveal 4 fresh cards (no Threat from the swept ones).

spells.name: Transmute
spells.desc: Gain gold equal to half the combined value (rounded down).

spells.name: Time Warp
spells.desc: Combined ≥ 10: gain +1 pick this turn and draw 1 hero card.
